company.name: Ritmo Business Coaching
company.description: Group and 1:1 business coaching programmes for owners of service businesses.

message.text: Hi! I run a business coaching programme with about 90 clients a year and a team of five. Onboarding new clients is completely manual — contracts, intake forms, Slack invites, calendar links — and it is eating my assistant alive. We bill around €45k a month so there is room to invest. Can we set up a call next week?
